My dear [Anna](../persons.html#195),
You did not give the name of your friend’s story, but I conclude that it is the Days of the Bruce.[^1] I had so many at the same time that it is not easy to distinguish between them.

However, the Bruce is a very nice story, and though I cannot certainly promise, I think it has a good chance.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps ‘In the Days of Good King Robert’ by ‘Biscachio’, which appeared in MP (Christmas 1880) 58-64.
